name: Quang Ngai provincial integrated data center (QNICT)
developer: Quang Ngai provincial IT center (QNICT) / Department of Information and Communications
notes: QNICT page describes the unit that manages and operates Quang Ngai's integrated data center (12 staff, 3-shift 24/7 operations); the provincial People's Committee office separately tendered an info-security assessment of its integrated data center. Public-sector scale, no MW disclosed.

name: Gia Lai provincial data center (strategic data pilot model with National Data Center)
developer: Gia Lai provincial government with National Data Center (Ministry of Public Security) and FPT IS
notes: 2026-01-14 signing ceremony between the National Data Center (Ministry of Public Security) and Gia Lai to build a pilot provincial data strategy; the province will form a modern provincial data center linked to the National Data Center. Agreement stage, no capacity disclosed.

name: Big Data center project at Nhon Hoi Economic Zone (Quy Nhon)
developer: Undisclosed Korean investors being courted by Binh Dinh province
notes: Binh Dinh invited Korean partners to invest in a Big Data center project of over 46 ha in Nhon Hoi Economic Zone, offering top incentives (10% corporate income tax for 15 years etc.); investment-seeking stage, no capacity disclosed.

name: Phu Yen provincial integrated data center
developer: Phu Yen Department of Information and Communications / provincial government
notes: Phu Yen's integrated data center (Trung tam Tich hop du lieu tinh Phu Yen) has operated under the provincial Department of Information and Communications since the early 2010s; a 2014 Tuoi Tre article on an internal disciplinary case confirms its existence and a thesis documents its development strategy to 2020. Public-sector scale, no MW disclosed.

name: Dak Lak provincial data center
developer: Dak Lak provincial government / Department of Science and Technology
notes: Provincial data center officially launched 2026-04-16 as shared 'digital heart' infrastructure connecting provincial agencies down to commune level for data governance; official provincial portal and state media. No MW disclosed.

name: Khanh Hoa data center hub development (Nha Trang)
notes: Khanh Hoa is officially positioned to become a national/regional data center hub (tourism, logistics and marine-economy advantages per provincial coverage); no concrete commercial data center project was found in public sources at check date - treat as policy orientation rather than a built project.

name: Lam Dong integrated data center and digital transformation center
developer: Lam Dong Department of Information and Communications / provincial government
notes: Official Lam Dong portal documents the 'Integrated Data Center and Digital Transformation Center' (Trung tam Tich hop du lieu va Chuyen doi so) under the provincial ICT agency; operates provincial shared data infrastructure. No MW disclosed.

name: Ninh Thuan candidate site survey for National Data Center and data industrial park
developer: National Data Center (Ministry of Public Security) with Ninh Thuan province
notes: Forum thread (VOZ) reports a National Data Center delegation led by Major General Nguyen Ngoc Cuong surveyed three candidate sites (450-700 ha) in Ninh Thuan for the National Data Center and a data industrial park; no official primary source located at check date - unverified, needs confirmation.

name: Tay Ninh provincial IT center / integrated data center
developer: Tay Ninh Department of Information and Communications
notes: VOV (state broadcaster) reports Tay Ninh's IT center was the first data center among Vietnamese state agencies certified ISO/IEC 27001:2013 for information security; it hosts the province's integrated systems. No MW disclosed.

name: Long Thanh centralized information technology zone (Khu cong nghe thong tin tap trung Long Thanh)
notes: Dong Nai is implementing the Long Thanh centralized IT zone (part of the Government-approved IT development plan 2021-2030) as the template for future data-center clusters under the province's 'southern energy and data hub' AI strategy; no capacity published.

name: Dong Nai provincial integrated data center (legacy, DC Vuon Mit)
notes: June 2026 provincial newspaper reports the old Dong Nai integrated data center (Vuon Mit) has aging equipment and mainly supports legacy data lookup while provincial data infrastructure is being renewed; no MW disclosed.

name: Dong Nai Data and IT Center
notes: Official Dong Nai provincial portal lists the 'Data and IT Center' (Trung tam Du lieu va CNTT) among provincial agencies operating the province's data infrastructure; no MW disclosed.
